newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end slightly higher after smooth SQ.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end slightly higher after smooth SQ.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed slightly higher on Friday in a market that was relieved by a fairly smooth settlement of March stock futures and options.
But participants were still cautious, waiting for the government to unveil specific measures to boost land liquidity, which could help pep up Japan's sluggish economy, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 average gained 23.16 points or 0.13 percent to finish at 17,923.64. The index had briefly sunk to a low of 17,616.79. Its June futures ended 30 points higher at 17,830.
Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd rose six yen to end at 407.
The second section index was down 7.51 points to end at 1,641.87, with 8.23 million shares traded.
The over-the-counter (OTC) index eased 3.79 points to 1,127.03.
